messages:
maria: Quick follow-up to the admit heuristics RFC — I sketched a tiny 'smoke' compatibility check that should catch ~90% of obvious rejects in <10s. Wanted feedback before I add it to CI.

 tj: Can you share the checklist/ops? short list please.

 maria: Sure — current sketch (fast, deterministic checks):
  - tokenizer roundtrip (encode->decode equality heuristics)
  - kv cache format tag or layout fingerprint
  - dtype/quantization hint (fp16 vs int8 mismatch)
  - attention mask/shape sanity (no unexpected dim reorder)
  - tiny-gen sanity (generate 8 tokens, check for crash/hangs)
  - ORT/onnx exportable flag (best-effort)

 ravi: How do we score it? thresholds will determine churn.

 maria: Minimal scoring: score = passed_checks / total_checks.
  - fail if score < 0.7 (hard reject)
  - 0.7 <= score < 0.85 -> enqueue fast bench (1-GPU, short workload)
  - score >= 0.85 -> allow canary onboarding

 anya: From product side we need clear failure reasons surfaced in Console (not just "failed"). Add failure_reasons list to model metadata.

 tj: Runtime note — kv-layout check needs to map to runtime adapters. Prefer explicit metadata tags like `kv_format: v2` or else run converter. If converter runs, capture conversion diffs.

 maria: Example quick CLI (proto):
```
redwood-admit --model-path ./models/x-7b --quick-check --out json
# output example: {"score":0.83, "failures":[], "details":{"tokenizer":"ok","kv_format":"v2"}}
```

 ci-bot: quick-check completed for model "x-7b-fp16" — PASS (score: 0.83) :white_check_mark:

 ravi: If borderline (0.65-0.75) send to fast-bench queue and run: latency p50/p95, memory alloc, sample-quality on 10 eval prompts. We should auto-fail only for crashes; otherwise surface regressions.

 maria: Long-term: move from heuristics -> declarative contract tests (per-model YAML specifying required contracts). Short-term: implement heuristic + fast-bench + kv migration script for common v1->v2 layouts.

 tj: Also add tiny synthetic workload generator to hit tokenization edge cases (long sequences, CJK, mixed whitespace). Saves time on weird tokenizer bugs.

 anya: Agreed. Also add user-visible reason codes: tokenizer_mismatch, kv_layout, quant_mismatch, seq_overflow, ort_export. Those map directly to Console UI strings.

 maria: I'll open a PR with the CLI, a docs page, and a CI template. tagging @tj @ravi for review, will add tests.

 tj: SGTM :thumbsup:

 ravi: +1, happy to review the fast-bench harness.

 anya: Thanks — this should cut admit friction a lot.

 maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/redwood/infra/pull/2123 — includes smoke CLI, mapping table, and sample output.

 ci-bot: created pipeline run redwood/admit-smoke/1890001299 triggered by PR 2123

 maria: Thanks all, will iterate on thresholds after a week of canaries.
